name: Shape Blur
description: WebGL2 canvas drawing a glowing outlined or filled shape (rect, circle, polygon, star or image silhouette) that blurs everywhere except under a lens that follows the pointer.
contents: Full-size WebGL2 canvas rendering a shape outline or fill with optional echo rings
Optional children layer centered above the canvas
behavior: A circular lens follows the pointer and sharpens the shape there, or blurs it when focus is on
When the pointer is away, the lens drifts on its own (idle) unless idle is false or reduced motion is set
Chromatic split of the edges grows with the blur amount
Shape can rotate continuously through spin
Image src is turned into a distance field so its transparent silhouette becomes the shape
Rendering pauses when offscreen and stops when everything has settled
editableByProps: Shape type, polygon/star sides, size, corner roundness and rotation or spin speed
Outline thickness, fill mode, number and spacing of echo rings
Color (any CSS color), blur amount, chroma split
Lens size, softness, inverted focus mode and idle drift
Image silhouette through src and content through children

needsCodeEdit.change: Change lens falloff or pointer follow speed
needsCodeEdit.where: frame function (follow and lens.power easing) and the lens line in COMPOSITE shader main
SHAPES constant and shapeDistance function in the SHAPE shader

fixed: Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unavailable
Fills its parent (h-full w-full), so the parent needs a defined height
Listens to pointermove on window, so the lens reacts to the pointer even outside the box (within a lensSize margin)
Device pixel ratio capped at 2, echoes capped at 24, sides clamped 3 to 12
Image src must be CORS-accessible and uses its alpha channel as the silhouette; failed images fall back to the chosen shape
Reduced motion disables idle drift and spin
Uses a float texture format when supported, otherwise 8-bit with more banding

options.look: Rounded rectangle fitted to the container
options.useWhen: A framed, card-like or full-bleed outline is wanted
A soft orb or ring focal point is wanted
A geometric badge or hexagon style mark is wanted
A playful or highlight accent is wanted
